info.title: Rask.Cli — the `rask` command-line tool
info.description: The `rask` .NET tool: a productivity front-door for the Rask framework. Scaffold a new project (`rask new`), run it with hot reload (`rask dev`), manage EF Core migrations (`rask db`), and deploy to a single host over SSH with auto-HTTPS (`rask deploy`) — a thin, dependency-free wrapper over the .NET SDK. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Rask.Cli`.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: rask — the Rask framework command-line tool

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Print a shell completion script (bash, zsh, or fish).

commands.name: db
commands.description: Manage EF Core migrations (add, remove, list, update, drop).

options.name: --project
options.description: Project containing the DbContext (default: found from the current directory).

options.name: --startup-project
options.description: Startup project (default: same as --project).

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext to use when the project defines more than one.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory for the migration files (add only).

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (drop only).

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Build and deploy the app to a single host over SSH (auto-HTTPS with --domain).

options.name: --host
options.description: SSH target to build and run on (remembered in .rask/deploy.json).

options.name: --domain
options.description: Public domain to serve over HTTPS via Caddy (implies ports 80/443).

options.name: --port
options.description: Published port when not using --domain (default: 8080).

options.name: --project
options.description: Project to deploy (default: found from the current directory).

options.name: --name
options.description: Container/app name (default: derived from the project).

options.name: --dockerfile
options.description: Dockerfile to build (default: ./Dockerfile).

options.name: --env-file
options.description: File of KEY=VALUE lines to pass to the container.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable to pass (repeatable).

options.name: --health-path
options.description: HTTP path probed for readiness before the blue-green swap (default: /).

options.name: --no-health-check
options.description: Skip the post-deploy HTTP health check.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the docker commands that would run without changing anything.

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Run the app with hot reload (dotnet watch).

options.name: --project
options.description: Project to run (default: the project in the current directory).

options.name: --no-hot-reload
options.description: Use a plain 'dotnet run' instead of 'dotnet watch' (no hot reload).

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Scaffold a page, component, CRUD feature, background job, or email into the current project.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write into (default: derived from the artifact).

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files instead of refusing.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching disk.

options.name: --route
options.description:
URL route for the page.
Feature options (rask generate feature):

options.name: --fields
options.description: Fields as Name:type,... (or pass them positionally).

options.name: --context
options.description: Reuse an existing DbContext instead of generating one.

options.name: --plural
options.description: Plural name for the feature folder/route (default: auto-pluralized).

options.name: --id
options.description: Primary-key type (default: guid).

options.name: --validation
options.description: Validation style: valueobjects (default), dataannotations, or fluent.

options.name: --bs
options.description: Render pages with Rask.Bootstrap (Bs*) components.

options.name: --modal
options.description: Fold create/edit into a modal on the list page (implies --bs).

options.name: --soft-delete
options.description: Soft-delete rows and add a Restore command.

options.name: --concurrency
options.description: Add optimistic-concurrency (row version) handling.

options.name: --events
options.description: Raise domain events on create/update/delete.

options.name: --outbox
options.description: Persist domain events via the transactional outbox (implies --events).

options.name: --tests
options.description: Generate a sibling <Project>.Tests project with domain + persistence tests.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Write files without adding packages or restoring.

options.name: --save-defaults
options.description: Remember this run's feature flags in .rask/generate.json for next time.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show Rask CLI, .NET SDK, and OS environment information.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a new Rask project from a template.

options.name: --template
options.description: Template to scaffold: server (default), wasm, wasm-hosted, or native.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to create the project in (default: ./<name>).

options.name: --name
options.description: Project name, if not given positionally.

options.name: --host
options.description: Native host mode: local (default) or server. Native template only.

options.name: --auth
options.description: Add cookie authentication (login + members pages).

options.name: --pwa
options.description: Add a PWA manifest, icon, and offline page.

options.name: --cqrs
options.description: Wire up Rask.Cqrs (server template only).

options.name: --docker
options.description: Add a Dockerfile and .dockerignore for container deploys.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the files that would be written without touching disk.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the tool version.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help for a command.
